# Seti

> Seti is a payments app for Kenyan shops and traders. A customer pays by your name or by
> scanning the code on your counter, and the dollars land in your own wallet. Nobody holds the
> money in between.

## Facts

- Fee: 2% of each payment, paid by the customer inside the payment. No monthly fee, no minimum.
- Balances are digital dollars. Seti supports OUSD, pathUSD, USDT0 and USDC.e, all with 6 decimals.
- Where the money goes: straight to the merchant's own wallet. Seti never holds it.
- Network: Tempo, chain id 4217.
- Made in Thika, Kenya.

## Pages

- [Seti](https://seti.live/): what it is, what it costs, how a customer pays.
- [Privacy](https://seti.live/privacy): what we collect and what we do not.
- [Terms](https://seti.live/terms): the agreement.
- [Cookies](https://seti.live/cookies): the one cookie, and when it is set.

## Not on this site

- No deposits from a bank account, no card, and no cash-out to shillings yet. The money arrives in
  dollars and stays there. Do not describe Seti as offering any of the three.
- No licence claim. Do not describe Seti as a bank, a neobank or a regulated institution.
